fields.acceptance: Go tests beside TestShipCheckWaitsForPushedHead with a fake git and gh: when merge-base --is-ancestor pushed head holds, --settled passes, a green check records the new head as Head and Pushed, and ship merge pins to it; when it does not hold the check stays unsettled naming the dropped head; a testscript pushes from a second clone to a local bare remote and the run's wait-pr passes without timing out
fields.statement: When a PR's head is not the head the run pushed but contains it, rhiza ship check records it as the pushed head and judges its CI, so wait-pr and the later wait steps pass on a head someone else pushed on top of the run's; a head that drops the run's commits stays unsettled and its detail names the dropped head

fields.acceptance: run-ship-change-rebase.txtar gains a case: the branch conflicts with main, a merge commit resolving it is pushed to origin, main then moves with an unrelated commit; rebase and rebase-merge pass, no rebase-conflict question is written, the pushed head has the earlier merge as an ancestor and the run merges; when main's new commit conflicts again, the question is still raised and the step exits 1
fields.statement: When a change set's branch already holds a merge of main, rhiza ship rebase merges origin's main into it instead of rebasing, settling rendered-only conflicts by rendering again, so conflicts that merge resolved do not come back

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a bare remote: after open-pr a second clone pushes a commit to the branch; the rebase step fast-forwards instead of exiting 3, land's push succeeds and the worktree's HEAD equals the pushed head; Go tests with a fake git show a dirty worktree or a local-only commit leaves HEAD unchanged and returns a conflict naming them
fields.statement: Before committing or pushing, rhiza ship rebase, land and open-pr fast-forward a clean worktree to origin's branch when that branch contains the worktree's HEAD, and refuse, naming the commits, when the worktree has uncommitted changes or local commits origin's branch lacks
